cat > $TMPDIR/esc.py <<'EOF'
import re,glob,os,collections
pat_case=re.compile(r'Case Number:\s*(\S+)')
total_forms=0; esc=[]; allrec=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/r2run-33ehzvyj/data/text/*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read()
    pages=re.split(r'=== page \d+',t)
    for p in pages:
        if 'Case Number' not in p: continue
        total_forms+=1
        m=re.search(r'recommends the following civil penalty:(.*?)(Abstentions|Additional Information|APPROVED|$)',p,re.S|re.I)
        rec=m.group(1) if m else ''
        if not m: print('NOREC',os.path.basename(f),pat_case.search(p).group(1))
        # headline penalty
        s=rec.replace('$$','$')
        am=re.search(r'\$\s*([\d,]+(?:,\s*\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)',s)
        pen=0.0
        if am: pen=float(re.sub(r'[,\s]','',am.group(1)))
        allrec.append((os.path.basename(f),pat_case.search(p).group(1),pen,rec.strip()))
        if re.search(r'ticket escalation',rec,re.I):
            esc.append((os.path.basename(f),pat_case.search(p).group(1),pen,rec.strip()))
print('forms',total_forms,'files',len(glob.glob('/tmp/r2run-33ehzvyj/data/text/*.txt')))
print('escalation cases',len(esc))
c=collections.Counter(e[2] for e in esc)
print(c.most_common())
for e in esc: print(e[0],e[1],e[2],repr(e[3][:120]))
EOF
